events.title: groundwork: 50 years of art, artists, education and community
events.description: Our 2026 program groundwork honours five decades of art, artists, education and community at UQ Art Museum.

events.title: Great Ocean Speaker Series | Indigenous Perspectives on Curation with Kimberley Moulton
events.description: This Speaker Series responds to core teachings in Indigenous Art History in the Australia Pacific Region, inviting leading First Nations and Great Ocean artists and curators to campus to speak to diverse themes in contemporary practice.

events.title: Reflective Motives: Online Reading Group
events.description: Join us to discuss key texts by Elder, educator and philosopher Dr Aunty Mary Graham, who will be presenting the keynote conversation with Tristen Harwood at Reflective Motives in November.

events.title: Old Words, Finding New Places: First languages in creative practices panel
events.description: Join us and hear from Quandamooka artist Elisa Jane Carmichael, Gunditjmara artist Dr Vicki Couzens, Gurindji/Malngin artist Leah Leaman, Gamilaraay/Wailwan and Biripi artist r e a and led by Pakana Curator Dr Zoe Rimmer for the first in a series of public conversations highlighting the embodiment, activation and renewed presence of First Nations languages.
